title: Composer dependency declared with a wildcard
description: composer.json declares a `require` entry whose constraint is `*`. Every release satisfies the constraint, so the install follows whatever Packagist serves next.
remediation: Pin the constraint the project tested.
limitation: It matches a `require` entry whose constraint is `*` in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
